subject: jumping spider
title: This Spider Can't Bite You, So It Hunts Mosquitoes Full of Your Blood

scenes.text: A spider near Lake Victoria craves human blood. It can't pierce your skin.
So it lets a mosquito do the work, then hunts the mosquito.
Given a choice, well-fed adults picked blood-filled female malaria mosquitoes about 79 percent of the time.
It spots them by posture: malaria mosquitoes rest tilted at 45 degrees.
Scientists even put worn socks near the spiders. All 109 lingered longer by the smell.
And a blood meal makes it more attractive to mates. A vampire, one mosquito removed.

description:
Evarcha culicivora, a 6.5 mm jumping spider from around Lake Victoria, feeds on human blood without ever biting a human.
It preferentially hunts blood-fed female Anopheles mosquitoes, recognises them by their 45-degree resting posture, is drawn to the smell of worn human socks, and spiders fed on blood become more attractive to the opposite sex.
Would you want this spider living in your house?
first_comment: One vampire spider can kill up to 20 female malaria mosquitoes in a single session. Would you let one live in your bedroom?
